svg.title: vedam
svg.desc: Six regular pentagons in fivefold symmetry: one centre pentagon with its apex pointing up, surrounded by five outer pentagons, each sharing one full edge with the centre pentagon. All six pentagons have the same circumradius. The diagonal-to-side ratio of any regular pentagon is the golden ratio phi, approximately 1.6180339887. A V accent is overlaid on top, with its apex at the bottom outermost vertex and its arms extending to the upper-outer vertices of the upper-left and upper-right outer pentagons. Each arm of the V is collinear through four points  an outer pentagon's outermost vertex, two centre-pentagon vertices, and the bottom apex  so the V traces two natural diagonals of the composition rather than being an arbitrary overlay.
